_comment: Firestore rules are deployed PER DATABASE. Without this file, `firebase deploy --only
firestore:rules` targets `(default)` -- which Karani does not use. It would report
success and guard neither database: events and grades both live in named databases
(karani-events, karani-grades), and the browser write path to grades would be left
open while the checklist showed green.
The two rule sets differ because the two databases have opposite postures. Events are
world-readable and create-only. Grades are readable only by an authenticated person and
writable only by that person, and nothing about them is public.
